0022600117.text: The Pistons (2-0, 1st in the Central and 1st in the East, on a two-game win streak) visit the Philadelphia 76ers (3-0, 1st in the Atlantic and 2nd in the East, on a three-game win streak) in a meeting of two unbeaten teams, with Detroit missing Ausar Thompson (ankle sprain) and Jalen Duren (hamstring strain). Philadelphia is without Ariel Hukporti (Achilles, surgery), Dominick Barlow (back fracture), Jabari Walker (knee soreness), Joel Embiid (heel), Tacko Fall (quadriceps strain), and VJ Edgecombe (abdomen bruise). Detroit won the 2025-26 season series 4-0, including a 116-93 victory in Philadelphia on April 4, 2026, and the two teams have not yet played each other in 2026-27.
